get.description: GET /bookings — list the authenticated user's bookings.

post.description:
POST /bookings — create a booking for the authenticated user.
Returns 409 if the seat is already taken for the requested segment.

get.description:
GET /bookings/{booking} — show a single booking.
Returns 403 if the booking does not belong to the authenticated user.

delete.description:
DELETE /bookings/{booking} — cancel (soft-delete) a booking.
Returns 403 if the booking does not belong to the authenticated user.

get.description:
GET /stations — list all stations.
Public endpoint, no authentication required.

GET /trips — list all trips.
Public endpoint, no authentication required.

GET /trips/{trip} — show a single trip.
Public endpoint, no authentication required.

get.summary: Get available seats for a trip between two stations
get.description:
GET /trips/{trip}/available-seats?start_station_id=&end_station_id=
Public endpoint, no authentication required.
